proposal.summary: Password reset functionality in CTROMS Terminal OS Port Portal discloses the verification code in the response to getverificationcode.jsp and returns predictable 'rand' cookie values; an attacker who knows a username can use these to reset that user's password via getresult.jsp.
proposal.affected_product: CTROMS Terminal OS - Port Portal (versions not specified)
proposal.cwe_quote: But this verification code written in the database is also reflected in the response of the request.

AV.quote: When the "userId" parameter is posted to "getverificationcode.jsp", a verification code is transmitted to the account's phone number for password reset.

PR.quote: In order to exploit this vulnerability, the username must be known.

C.quote: Exploiting this vulnerability create a new password for the user you specified and present it to you.

I.quote: Exploiting this vulnerability create a new password for the user you specified and present it to you.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerability on a test instance and confirm which endpoints echo the verification code and return the 'rand' cookies; collect full request/response examples, impacted versions, and reproduce the reset flow to create a patch or mitigation.

evidence_quotes.claim: Verification code is reflected in response
evidence_quotes.quote: But this verification code written in the database is also reflected in the response of the request.
In order to exploit this vulnerability, the username must be known.

evidence_quotes.claim: Verification code sent when posting userId to getverificationcode.jsp
evidence_quotes.quote: When the "userId" parameter is posted to "getverificationcode.jsp", a verification code is transmitted to the account's phone number for password reset.
The second vector is the "rand" cookie values returned in this request. These values are md5.

evidence_quotes.claim: Successful reset creates new password and reveals it
evidence_quotes.quote: Exploiting this vulnerability create a new password for the user you specified and present it to you.
